generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a water lily of ponds and slow water across eastern North America, rooted in the mud a metre or so down by a creeping rhizome, with round, notched, floating pads 15 to 30 cm across on long petioles and fragrant white many-petalled flowers held just above the water. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species, measured from the water's surface (the plant's origin) to the tops of its flowers: about 18 cm at 3 years and 20 cm at 10. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: green pads, white flowers with a yellow centre.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.
